Alkat Sp ZOO Names New Managing Director in Leadership Transition

Alkat Sp ZOO, a leading player in Poland’s gas and water utilities sector, has announced the appointment of Marek Jankowski as its new Managing Director, effective immediately. Jankowski succeeds Anna Piotrowska, who will be stepping down after six years in the role, the company confirmed on Tuesday.

Jankowski brings over two decades of experience in utility operations and infrastructure development, most recently serving as Chief Operating Officer at Majora Utilities. His appointment is expected to bolster Alkat Sp ZOO’s ongoing modernization programme, which has seen significant capital investment over the past three years.

“We are delighted to welcome Marek Jankowski to Alkat Sp ZOO,” said Wojciech Nowak, Chair of the Supervisory Board. “His extensive background in both gas and water services will be invaluable as we continue to invest in network resilience and customer service.”

According to the Polish Utilities Federation, Poland’s utilities sector is experiencing an uptick in infrastructure spending, with over PLN 5 billion allocated to modernization projects in 2023. Alkat Sp ZOO has played a prominent role, securing long-term contracts for water supply in several voivodeships and expanding its natural gas distribution network.

Industry analysts note that Jankowski’s appointment signals continuity for the company. “Alkat Sp ZOO has prioritized stability and operational excellence,” said Elzbieta Kowalczyk, an energy sector analyst at Warsaw-based consultancy Utility Insight. “The new leadership is likely to maintain this trajectory, focusing on efficiency gains and digital transformation.”

In a statement, Jankowski said, “I am honoured to lead Alkat Sp ZOO at this pivotal time. Together with our dedicated team, I look forward to driving innovation and maintaining the highest standards of service for our communities.”

The company has confirmed that Jankowski will meet with staff across its regional offices in the coming weeks as part of the leadership transition process.
